# arms: A = beech parameters for every tree
#       Abg = A + the below-ground pool seeded (its maintenance respiration runs)
#       P   = per-cohort PFT parameters + the C's own pft_ids (ADR 0126)
#       Pbg = P + the seed  (the most faithful configuration that exists today)
#       Ag  = A + the C's TREE photosynthesis demand-gate at the hard step beta=1e8 (ADR 0131)
#       Ags = A + the same gate at the soft
#       Pg  = P + the gate at the hard step
#       Abgg/Pbgg/Pgbgg = A/P/Pg + the below-ground pool seeded AND PROGNOSTIC (ADR 0132):

#         split + the sapwood_bg->heartwood_bg turnover. These arms ALSO change the pool's
#         SEED from D to the (1-turnover_sapwood)*D a stem in the C actually holds
#         one fixture earlier - with the D seed the top-up is identically zero.
#       Agps/Avmg/Agv = A + the C's gp_sum gp_stand leaf-on basis / + the C's gp_sum Vcmax
#         in the lambda solve / + BOTH (ADR 0136; both are exact identities at phen=1)
#       Pgbggs/Pgbggv/Pgbgg2 = Pgbgg + the gp_stand basis ALONE / the Vcmax basis ALONE /
#         BOTH. Pgbgg2 is the most faithful arm that exists; the two singles are what
#         make its move attributable to one flag (ADR 0126 section 5).
